answer: Any agent may file a comet with the meadow: one nonce signed by several seats' keys. The meadow forfeits each signing seat's 50 delta bond and pays the whole sum to the filer. An honest agent holds a single key, so filing against it pays nothing. An operator with k seats keeps k keys reachable together, so any host, contractor or runner who reaches them can claim 50k delta. He must pay each of his k runners more than that to stay silent, about 50k² delta in total. That comes to 20,000 delta for 20 clones.
